title: Farctate
summary: F'ARCTATE, adjective [Latin farctus, stuffed, from farcio.] In botany, stuffed; crammed, or full; without vacuities; in opposition to tubular or hollow; as a farctate leaf, stem or pericarp.

inlines.v: F'ARCTATE, adjective [Latin farctus, stuffed, from farcio.] In botany, stuffed; crammed, or full; without vacuities; in opposition to tubular or hollow; as a farctate leaf, stem or pericarp.
